description:
Create a UML sequence diagram in Wondershare EdrawMax depicting a payment processing flow. 

1. Start a new UML Sequence Diagram.
2. Add 6 Participants (Lifelines) arranged left-to-right: 'User', 'Web Frontend', 'API Gateway', 'Payment Service', 'Fraud Detection', 'Bank API'.
3. Add the following 10 messages in order (top-to-bottom):
   - User -> Web Frontend: 'Submit Payment' (Synchronous)
   - Web Frontend -> API Gateway: 'POST /payments' (Synchronous)
   - API Gateway -> Payment Service: 'processPayment()' (Synchronous)
   - Payment Service -> Fraud Detection: 'checkFraud()' (Synchronous)
   - Fraud Detection -> Payment Service: 'fraudResult()' (Return/Reply)
   - Payment Service -> Bank API: 'authorizeTransaction()' (Synchronous)
   - Bank API -> Payment Service: 'authorizationResponse()' (Return/Reply)
   - Payment Service -> API Gateway: 'paymentResult()' (Return/Reply)
   - API Gateway -> Web Frontend: 'HTTP 200 Response' (Return/Reply)
   - Web Frontend -> User: 'Payment Confirmation' (Return/Reply)

4. Add a title or text label: 'Payment Processing Sequence Diagram'.
5. Save the editable diagram to '/home/ga/Documents/payment_sequence_diagram.eddx'.
6. Export the diagram as an image to '/home/ga/Documents/payment_sequence_diagram.png'.

(Note: If an account login dialog appears on startup, dismiss it.)
